title: Compose Store Graphql Api
description: Replace compose-store JSON-RPC with GraphQL over HTTP, wire native KitStore for backbone commands, add GraphiQL dev config in launch.json.
summary: Consolidated compose-store into a single Rust source file: moved the Axum GraphQL sidecar implementation and all HTTP tests into compose/store/bin.rs, removed compose/store/jsonrpc.rs and compose/store/tests/rpc.rs, and updated compose/store/AGENTS.md to reference the single-file structure. Verified cargo test -p compose-store with ticket-local CARGO_TARGET_DIR: 4 passed, 0 failed; cargo emitted existing compose library warnings and one incremental cleanup access warning after the passing run.
